applicant_utility.summary: The scholarship here is invitation-driven: nothing is uploaded and no form is public, so if the email in early February does not reach you, you cannot apply at all. Make sure the address on your University Admissions account is one you actively check, because the university explicitly tells applicants to look in spam before contacting them. Two dates genuinely bind you in advance - a Umeå programme must be priority 1 by 15 January and the application fee paid by 2 February - and both are national University Admissions deadlines you can miss without realising the scholarship route has closed. The award is a full or partial tuition waiver only, with no stipend, so budget for the whole of living in Umeå yourself. Note that the invitation is tied to your priority-1 programme: if you are admitted to a different Umeå programme instead, you cannot redirect the scholarship.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Non-EU/EEA applicants who have committed to Umeå as their priority-1 choice and can self-finance living costs while studying.
application_readiness_checklist: Set a Umeå University programme as priority 1 on University Admissions by 15 January and do not change it afterwards
Pay the University Admissions application fee by 2 February (fee-exempt but tuition-liable applicants are still eligible)
Verify the email address on your University Admissions account and monitor it including the spam folder from 4 February
Exclude the Master's Programme in Sustainability Reporting and Financial Analysis from consideration, as it is ineligible
Register interest as soon as the form opens - the published window closed 23:59 CET on 4 March 2026
common_rejection_risks: Umeå not being priority 1 by 15 January, which removes eligibility for the invitation
Not receiving or not spotting the invitation email, since the form is not publicly available
Being admitted to a different Umeå programme and expecting to transfer the scholarship to it
Applying for the Sustainability Reporting and Financial Analysis master's, which is excluded as a double degree
Current students on study leave, who are explicitly not considered eligible
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Any tuition not covered by a partial waiver, plus accommodation, food, insurance, travel and residence-permit costs - no living-cost allowance is published.
document_audit: There is no document upload; the registration form plus your admission file are the entire evidence base
The invitation email goes to the address held by University Admissions, not to a Umeå-issued address
Only priority-1 applicants and second-year master's students receive invitations
Current students must prove they paid the spring semester tuition fee and are registered
A separate Design by Umeå stream exists for design master's programmes, funded by a donation from Umeå municipality
alerts: The university notes its dates are preliminary and subject to change, and the page still shows the 2026 timeline at the time of checking
If you get a place on a Umeå programme other than your priority-1 first choice, you cannot register interest for that programme instead
Second-year master's students are eligible, so current students should not assume the scheme is new-applicants only

The Swedish Institute Global Professionals and Pioneering Women in STEM scholarships (full tuition plus a SEK 12,000 monthly stipend and a SEK 15,000 travel grant) are separate, Swedish Institute-run awards with full tuition and a stipend
Students on study leave are not eligible
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: University Admissions application with Umeå as priority 1 and fee paid, then registration of interest through the link in the personal invitation email, with the outcome sent by email in mid-April.
